non_goals.enforcement: analysis_only; no target-scoped candidate; target-strict baseline (baseline_expected_target_strict) recorded as analysis_only/not_verified
non_goals.claim: Hard-case non-template targets (inline loops, sprintf, multicall, nonconst, UAF, heap guard) are AI-benchmark/research evidence, not deterministic engine successes; strict target-scoped deterministic baselines (baseline_expected_target_strict) record analysis_only/not_verified instead of a repaired claim.
non_goals.productization_criteria: target-strict deterministic recovery for the sprintf/inline-loop/multicall/nonconst families, each with a reviewed fixture + runtime oracle and baseline_expected_target_strict=verified_patch; format-aware sink templates are required for sprintf
non_goals.fallback: analysis_only; no target-scoped candidate; the target-strict benchmark baseline records not_verified and never claims repair
non_goals.research_acceptance: deterministic template coverage for the hard-case families with target-mode patch-ownership evidence and a real PoC/regression case

non_goals.enforcement: no verified; leaf/instruction allowlist refuses calls and non-whitelisted code
non_goals.claim: AI assembly path accepts only a leaf-level reviewed block and cannot express repairs that need external calls/helpers.
non_goals.productization_criteria: deterministic validator + regression fixture for external-call-free assembly leaf blocks; the AI candidate is accepted only through the unified evidence-profile gate
non_goals.fallback: no verified; the leaf/instruction allowlist refuses calls and non-whitelisted code, so no candidate is produced
non_goals.research_acceptance: non-loop target-mode AI repair verified with the call whitelist plus import/stub resolution and a native PoC/regression gate

non_goals.enforcement: no verified; leaf/allowlist machine-code validator; AI never owns acceptance
non_goals.claim: AI binary path emits only structurally validated leaf blocks; the deterministic unified gate decides acceptance.
non_goals.productization_criteria: deterministic re-verification of machine-code leaf blocks plus a regression fixture; the deterministic unified gate remains the acceptance owner
non_goals.fallback: no verified; AI binary output is only a structurally validated candidate for the deterministic gate
non_goals.research_acceptance: non-leaf binary_direct repair accepted by the deterministic structural validator and a native PoC/regression gate

non_goals.enforcement: analysis_only; no candidate for unrecoverable destination capacity
non_goals.claim: Copy sinks whose destination capacity is not recoverable by same-function analysis (dynamic sizes, pointer+offset aliases, cross-function allocations).
non_goals.productization_criteria: same-function capacity recovery for dynamic sizes, pointer+offset aliases and cross-function allocations, with a fixture + runtime oracle and a reviewed list of the newly recoverable subset
non_goals.fallback: analysis_only for unrecoverable destinations; no candidate bytes
non_goals.research_acceptance: cross-function/alias capacity proof that never over-estimates, checked by the runtime oracle and evidenced by a fixture

non_goals.enforcement: analysis_only; no deterministic template; no download
non_goals.claim: sprintf/format-expansion, UAF/lifetime and integer/loop deterministic repair templates (AI research only).
non_goals.productization_criteria: deterministic templates for sprintf/format-string expansion, UAF/lifetime and integer/loop families, each with a fixture + runtime oracle; format-aware sink template + regression fixture for sprintf specifically
non_goals.fallback: analysis_only; no deterministic template and no download
non_goals.research_acceptance: per-class template + fixture + runtime oracle (sprintf format-aware, UAF lifetime model, integer/loop deterministic templates)

non_goals.enforcement: unsupported; no rewrite backend for these containers/architectures
non_goals.claim: arm32, riscv, mips, powerpc and big-endian machine-code repair.
non_goals.productization_criteria: container/writer + gate cell + fixtures for arm32/riscv/mips/powerpc or big-endian input; until all exist the matrix cell must stay out of the claimed universe
non_goals.fallback: unsupported; no rewrite backend for these containers
non_goals.research_acceptance: new arch decoder + writer + runtime cell with fixtures and capability-contract entry

non_goals.claim: 32-bit Mach-O and fat Mach-O rewriting (thin little-endian only).
non_goals.productization_criteria: fat/32-bit Mach-O rewrite backend with reparse + fixture + gate cell evidence
non_goals.research_acceptance: fat/32-bit Mach-O container handling with runtime capability matrix and negative tests

non_goals.enforcement: unsupported/not_run for native execution beyond the Mach-O path
non_goals.claim: Windows native execution and macOS native execution beyond the existing Mach-O path.
non_goals.productization_criteria: Windows and non-Mach-O macOS native runtime runners with a measured runtime-capability probe, fixture and acceptance case
non_goals.research_acceptance: Windows/macOS native runner with capability probe, acceptance case and fixture

non_goals.claim: External-PoC replay is unavailable for PE/arm64 by design; only emulated/static evidence exists and a PoC requirement stays inconclusive.
non_goals.productization_criteria: a PE external-PoC runner on a supported host with a fixture + native/emulated runtime oracle and capability probe poc_available=true; PE PoC evidence is then gate-validated
non_goals.fallback: not_run; PE PoC manifests are never executed, simulated or reported as verified
non_goals.research_acceptance: PE external-PoC runner on a supported host with a fixture, native/emulated oracle and capability poc_available=true

non_goals.claim: External-PoC replay is unavailable for PE/i386 by design; PE PoC manifests are never executed or faked.
non_goals.productization_criteria: a PE external-PoC runner on a supported host with a fixture + native/emulated runtime oracle and capability probe poc_available=true; PE PoC evidence is then gate-validated
non_goals.fallback: not_run; PE PoC manifests are never executed, simulated or reported as verified
non_goals.research_acceptance: PE external-PoC runner on a supported host with a fixture, native/emulated oracle and capability poc_available=true

non_goals.claim: External-PoC replay is unavailable for PE/x86_64 by design; the gate reports the missing evidence, it does not simulate it.
non_goals.productization_criteria: a PE external-PoC runner on a supported host with a fixture + native/emulated runtime oracle and capability probe poc_available=true; PE PoC evidence is then gate-validated
non_goals.fallback: not_run; PE PoC manifests are never executed, simulated or reported as verified
non_goals.research_acceptance: PE external-PoC runner on a supported host with a fixture, native/emulated oracle and capability poc_available=true

non_goals.enforcement: unavailable/not_run; external PoC for macho/x86_64 is unavailable on arm64 hosts and platform-gated on others; no fabricated PoC
non_goals.claim: Mach-O x86_64 external PoC replay is a platform capability; the capability probe makes availability/reason explicit and the runner selects no runner when unavailable.
non_goals.productization_criteria: run on matching macOS host with external PoC evidence
non_goals.fallback: native function-level evidence only; external PoC reported not_run/unavailable
non_goals.research_acceptance: run on a matching macOS host with external-PoC evidence and capability poc_available=true
